title: ATMI Solo
bottom_line: ATMI is a Jesuit-run group: Swiss Jesuits founded Politeknik ATMI Surakarta in 1968, it runs under Yayasan Karya Bakti Surakarta, and a sister foundation, Yayasan Karya ATMI (chair Yakobus Rudiyanto SJ), runs Politeknik Industri ATMI and PT ATMI Cikarang in Cikarang. Around the Solo polytechnic sit teaching-factory companies: PT ATMI Solo (Leanturn CNC lathe at 45.66% TKDN, metal furniture and racks, KIRANA-brand medical devices), PT ATMI-IGI Center (moulds and injection), PT ATMI Duta Engineering (sheet metal), PT ATMI BizDEC (training) and PT ATMI Kreasi Energi. No source names their shareholders or PT ATMI Solo's directors; only the distributor PT Almik Kurnia Bersama names its owners (the two foundations and two Mikael cooperatives). Third parties confirm only a few ties (ARBURG's 2024 MoU and machine, the Jacobs Foundation prize to longtime head J.B. Casutt SJ, the foundation's audited accounts, the TKDN and EMIS registers); the April 2026 LK Group MOU, Solinatra, the IKN letter of intent, Kemenperin's award and the customer logos (Astra Daihatsu, Astra Honda, Stanley, Dharma Polimetal, YPTI) are ATMI's own claims. Money comes from industry orders, ministry grants and education buyers such as Gorontalo province, PT PMP Jember and Timor-Leste's FDCH, while the lathe is sold through PT Buana Prima Raya and the e-catalogue to unnamed SMKs and polytechnics.

entities.name: Politeknik ATMI Surakarta
entities.legal_name: Politeknik ATMI Surakarta (formerly Akademi Teknik Mesin Industri, ATMI)
entities.what: Jesuit-run manufacturing college founded 1968 as an academy, a polytechnic since 2011-12; runs production-based education (two-thirds practice) and lists seven 'Industry' companies on its site.

entities.name: Yayasan Karya Bakti Surakarta
entities.what: Foundation (yayasan) under which ATMI has run since 1968; Jl. Mojo 1, Laweyan, the same address as PT ATMI Solo and SMK Mikael; 2024 accounts audited by KAP Ganung AB. Its chair is not named publicly.

entities.name: Society of Jesus, Indonesian Province (Jesuits)
entities.what: Catholic religious order (not a company). ATMI says the Indonesian province manages and owns the polytechnic; Swiss Jesuits founded it in 1968 and Jesuits head both ATMI polytechnics and Yayasan Karya ATMI.

entities.name: PT ATMI Solo
entities.what: Group's main factory: the polytechnic's production workshop turned PT (incorporated 23 Nov 2011, operating from early 2012). Makes the Leanturn LT 300-100 CNC lathe (ATMIPRO, TKDN 45.66%), special machines, office, school and workshop furniture, lockers, racks and hospital equipment; 30 TKDN-listed products, BMP 10.5%.

entities.name: ATMIPRO
entities.what: Brand on PT ATMI Solo's Leanturn LT 300-100 CNC lathe in the TKDN register; its logo ('The Rainbow of Excellence') also appears separately among ATMI group logos. No separate company found.

entities.name: KIRANA medical-device brands (Dentech, GTech, Ortech, Labtech)
entities.what: Marks on about 20 medical devices certified under PT ATMI SOLO in the TKDN register: dental chairs (42.6-44.1%), ECGs, infusion and syringe pumps, patient monitor, operating lamps, table and ceiling pendants, and the HbPRO haemoglobin tester (30.3-45.4%). Brand owner not found.

entities.name: PT ATMI-IGI Center
entities.legal_name: PT ATMI-IGI Center (IGI = Indonesian German Institute)
entities.what: ATMI's teaching-industry company for product development, mould and tool making, metal stamping and plastic and bioplastic injection; named after the 2001-2009 Indonesia-German technical project; KBLI 25920. Hosts the Solinatra-ATMI Center of Excellence.

entities.name: PT ATMI Duta Engineering (ADE)
entities.what: 'One stop sheet metal solution': laser cutting, bending, welding and fabrication (enclosures, sheet-metal furniture, facades) on TRUMPF machines; a workplace for ATMI engineers and training site for ATMI and SMK Mikael students; KBLI 25992. Founding year not published.

entities.name: PT ATMI BizDEC
entities.what: ATMI's consultancy and training company ('ATMI BizDEC International' logo); runs the joint 'Training Center ATMI - PT ATMI BizDEC'; its staff ran Timorese students' matriculation in 2025. No website found.

entities.name: PT ATMI Kreasi Energi
entities.legal_name: PT ATMI Kreasi Energi (listed as 'PT. ATMI Kreasi Energy'; logo 'PT. AKE')
entities.what: ATMI group business unit; a 2016 UGM thesis ranks it a first-priority unit for investment. What it does is not published.

entities.name: PT Almik Kurnia Bersama (ALMIK)
entities.what: Distributor founded 28 Dec 2003 by ATMI and its alumni to sell ATMI products and buy for ATMI; sole distributor of South Korean PKLNS smart boards since 2017; also sells ALMIK heavy-duty cabinets. Office at Grha LN, Bekasi Selatan.

entities.name: PT ATMI Cikarang
entities.what: Stamping and toolmaking company on the Cikarang ATMI campus (Jababeka Education Park), operating since 1 May 2014: moulds, dies, stamping and precision parts, special-purpose machines; claims ISO 9001:2015; presses 16-250 t; KBLI 25910.

entities.name: Politeknik Industri ATMI (Polin ATMI Cikarang)
entities.what: Sister polytechnic in Jababeka founded by J.B. Casutt SJ; D3 classes from 1 Sep 2003; renamed Politeknik Industri ATMI by decree 319/KPT/I/2019 (30 Apr 2019); sells courses to industry through its training centre.

entities.name: Yayasan Karya ATMI (Karya ATMI Cikarang Foundation)
entities.what: Foundation that oversees Politeknik Industri ATMI; PT ATMI Cikarang operates 'under the patronage of KARYA ATMI CIKARANG FOUNDATION' (read as the same body). Chair Yakobus Rudiyanto SJ; a shareholder of Almik.

entities.name: SMK Katolik St. Mikael Surakarta
entities.what: Jesuit vocational school (formerly STM Mikael) on the same Jl. Mojo 1 campus ('Kolese Mikael'); machining, mechatronics and software courses; own production unit for moulds, dies and precision parts; co-developed ATMI's EDU CNC machines.

entities.name: PT ATMI Mikael Fortuna
entities.what: In Kemenperin's company directory (KBLI 25920, metal-working services). The name pairs ATMI and Mikael, but no source ties it to the group.

entities.name: KOKAMI (Koperasi Keluarga Alumni Mikael)
entities.what: Cooperative of Kolese Mikael alumni; named by Almik as one of its shareholders.

entities.name: KOPKARMIK (Koperasi Karyawan Mikael)
entities.what: Cooperative of ATMI employees; named by Almik as one of its shareholders.

entities.name: IKAMI (Ikatan Keluarga Alumni Kolese Mikael)
entities.what: Alumni association of SMK St. Mikael, Politeknik ATMI Surakarta and Politeknik Industri ATMI; ATMI calls alumni its door to industry (teaching, internships). Its logo sits among ATMI group logos.

entities.name: Politeknik Cristo Re (Maumere)
entities.what: Polytechnic set up by ministry decree 590/M/2020 (24 Jun 2020) under the Diocese of Maumere's Cristo Re Foundation; overseen by PT Triputra Edukasi Nusantara; ATMI lists it as an academic affiliate.

entities.name: Triputra Group (PT Triputra Edukasi Nusantara)
entities.legal_name: PT Triputra Investindo Arya (group site); PT Triputra Edukasi Nusantara (education arm)
entities.what: Diversified group (agribusiness, manufacturing incl. 'Dharma Group', trading, energy, education); its education arm oversees Politeknik Cristo Re.

entities.name: PT Dharma Polimetal
entities.what: Auto-parts maker; logo on PT ATMI Cikarang's client list; funded ATMI scholarships (May 2022 announcement). Its place in Triputra's 'Dharma Group' is inferred.

entities.name: Bengkel Misi Santo Yoseph (Maumere)
entities.what: Church mission workshop turned youth skills centre that works with 'ATMI Solo'; makes wooden furniture, farm machines and food products sold under the 'Mai Sai' brand.

entities.name: Andreas Sugijopranoto SJ
entities.what: Jesuit priest; Director of Politeknik ATMI Surakarta since 2021 (also spelled Sugijapranata); director of the academy 2009-2012; ATMI business and finance manager 2005-2007.

entities.name: T. (Tiburtius) Agus Sriyono SJ
entities.what: Jesuit; signed ATMI Surakarta's site greeting as Director (before 2021); moved to Politeknik Industri ATMI in 2022 and is now its Director.

entities.name: Yakobus Rudiyanto SJ
entities.what: Jesuit; Chair (Ketua) of Yayasan Karya ATMI.

entities.name: Yustinus Wahyo Nursanto
entities.what: Director (also styled operations director) of PT ATMI-IGI Center, 2023-2026; signed the ARBURG MoUs and, as 'Director of ATMI Group', the April 2026 LK Group MOU.

entities.name: Johann Balthasar (J.B.) Casutt SJ
entities.what: Swiss Jesuit priest; head of ATMI from about 1971, credited with its industry-financed dual-system model; founded the Cikarang campus (2003); 2009 Jacobs Foundation Best Practice Prize.

entities.name: Rm. Chetelat SJ
entities.what: Swiss Jesuit priest named by ATMI as its founder in 1968; handed leadership to Casutt three years later.

entities.name: FX Suryadi
entities.what: Vice Director IV (cooperation and career centre) of Politeknik ATMI Surakarta in 2021, 2023 and 2025.

entities.name: Antonius Agung Nugroho
entities.what: Chair of IKAMI, the Kolese Mikael alumni association, 2023-2026; ATMI alumnus.

entities.name: Wikan Sakarinto
entities.what: Director General of Vocational Education (2020-2022); attended the first Leanturn shipment at ATMI on 17 Dec 2021.

entities.name: PT Buana Prima Raya
entities.what: Education and industrial equipment supplier (est. 2001, Cempaka Mas, Jakarta, per a Devex snippet); handled marketing and sales of the Leanturn lathe.

entities.name: PT Sucofindo (Persero)
entities.what: State inspection firm; calculated the Leanturn's local-content (TKDN) value in 2021.

entities.name: Solusi Klik
entities.what: Reseller on the INAPROC government e-catalogue; lists the ATMIPRO Leanturn LT 300-100 (snippet), as it lists DTECH's SUPERMILL.

entities.name: ARBURG Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesian arm of German injection-moulding machine maker ARBURG; MoU with ATMI-IGI in 2024, continued in 2025, new MoU in Aug 2026; supplied an ALLROUNDER 470 H for training.

entities.name: LK Group (L.K. Technology)
entities.legal_name: L.K. Technology Holdings Limited (HK 00558); signing unit Guangdong LKIMM Co., Ltd.
entities.what: Chinese die-casting, injection-moulding and CNC machine maker; Indonesian subsidiary registered in 2024, technical service centre under construction; strategic MOU with ATMI Group on 20 Apr 2026.

entities.name: Solinatra Group B.V.
entities.what: Dutch maker of plastic-free, biodegradable materials; runs the Solinatra-ATMI Center of Excellence with ATMI-IGI (since 2023).

entities.name: Otorita Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN Authority)
entities.what: Authority building the new capital; signed a Letter of Intent with the Solinatra-PT ATMI IGI Center of Excellence at Hannover Messe on 24 Apr 2024.

entities.name: Kementerian Perindustrian (Kemenperin)
entities.what: Ministry of Industry: runs the TKDN register (30 PT ATMI SOLO products) and the company directory; ranked PT ATMI IGI Center 3rd for 'best Hannover Messe 2023 investment' in its Dec 2023 ARSI awards.

entities.name: Ditjen Pendidikan Vokasi
entities.what: Vocational-education directorate; backed the Leanturn project and its Director General attended the first shipment (Dec 2021).

entities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Technology (Kemdiktisaintek; earlier Kemenristek)
entities.what: Funded ATMI's Campus 3 (Kampus Arrupe, 2020) through the Polytechnic Education Development Project (as Kemenristek) and gave a 2025 PP-PTS equipment grant.

entities.name: Sekolah Vokasi UGM
entities.what: Partner in a 2021 Kedaireka Matching Fund proposal for Leanturn measuring and calibration equipment; the proposal was not approved.

entities.name: Universitas Sanata Dharma
entities.what: Jesuit university; ran an engineer-profession (Ir.) programme for 39 Kolese Mikael lecturers and instructors, 2024-2025.

entities.name: Akademi Teknik PIKA (Semarang)
entities.what: Jesuit woodworking academy; one of five schools ATMI mentored under the Kampus Pendamping Kemitraan programme (2020).

entities.name: Polman Bandung
entities.what: State manufacturing polytechnic; ATMI says it helped set it up.

entities.name: Politeknik Manufaktur Astra (Polman Astra)
entities.what: Astra group's manufacturing polytechnic; ATMI says it helped set it up.

entities.name: Sugar Group (Lampung)
entities.what: Sugar producer; ATMI says it helped set up a vocational institution at 'PT Sugar Group Lampung'.

entities.name: Solo Techno Park
entities.what: Teaching factory and training centre in Surakarta that ATMI lists among its own activities.

entities.name: Legrand Indonesia (PT Trias Indra Saputra)
entities.what: Indonesian company of French electrical group Legrand (per ATMI's 2021 deck); gives job orders and mentors students inside an ATMI study programme.

entities.name: Swiss civilian service (Zivildienst)
entities.what: Swiss alternative to military service; ATMI's 2021 deck lists 'Civi (civil service dari swiss)' among the institutions it works with.

entities.name: Jacobs Foundation
entities.what: Swiss foundation; gave J.B. Casutt SJ its 2009 Best Practice Prize for his work at ATMI.

entities.name: BBPLK Bandung
entities.legal_name: Balai Besar Pengembangan Latihan Kerja Bandung
entities.what: Government vocational-training centre; sent three instructors on a 240-hour course at Training Center ATMI - PT ATMI BizDEC (May-Jun 2021).

entities.name: Pemerintah Provinsi Gorontalo
entities.what: Provincial government; under an MoU signed after Dec 2015 it pays tuition and living costs for Gorontalo students at ATMI (since 2016).

entities.name: PT PMP Jember
entities.what: Company funding full ATMI scholarships for Jember students as CSR (annual gathering, 20 Sep 2025). What PMP does is not stated.

entities.name: Adaro Foundation
entities.what: Foundation of the Adaro group; with YPKAAR it funded pocket-money scholarships for 30 ATMI students in 2021-22.

entities.name: FDCH (Fundo de Desenvolvimento do Capital Humano)
entities.legal_name: Fundo de Desenvolvimento do Capital Humano
entities.what: Timor-Leste's public human-capital fund; sponsors 15 Timorese students at ATMI from 2025-26.

entities.name: PT Hitachi Construction Machinery Indonesia
entities.what: Construction-machinery maker; sent staff on a conventional-lathe course at ATMI Cikarang's training centre (2024).

entities.name: PT Mitsubishi Motors Krama Yudha
entities.what: Mitsubishi motor-vehicle company; sent its third batch of staff on a CNC milling course at ATMI Cikarang (Sep-Oct 2024).

entities.name: PT YPTI (Yogya Presisi Tehnikatama Industri)
entities.legal_name: PT Yogya Presisi Tehnikatama Industri (TKDN spelling)
entities.what: Precision-machining firm and TKDN-listed CNC builder (earlier project notes); its logo is on ATMI-IGI's and PT ATMI Cikarang's customer lists and on Polin ATMI's partner list.

entities.name: PT Indonesia Stanley Electric
entities.what: Automotive lighting maker; its logo is on PT ATMI Cikarang's client list and ATMI-IGI's automotive list.

entities.name: PT Astra Honda Motor (AHM)
entities.what: Honda motorcycle maker; its logo is on ATMI-IGI's automotive list and Polin ATMI's partner list.

entities.name: PT Astra Daihatsu Motor (ADM)
entities.what: Daihatsu car maker; its logo is on PT ATMI Cikarang's client list.

entities.name: Polytron (PT Hartono Istana Teknologi)
entities.what: Electronics maker; its logo is on ATMI-IGI's electronics list.

entities.name: Quick (CV Karya Hidup Sentosa)
entities.what: Farm-machinery maker (QUICK hand tractors); its QUICK logo is on ATMI-IGI's 'Agriculture, Medical' customer list. Same id as the Quick network map.

entities.name: Indonesia Mould & Dies Industry Association (IMDIA)
entities.what: Mould and die makers' association; its logo is on ATMI-IGI's partner list.

entities.name: TRUMPF
entities.what: Machine-tool maker; ADE lists TruLaser 3030, TruDisk 3030 fiber, TruBend 7036 and 3066, TrumaBend V130 and TruMark 508 machines.

entities.name: Salvagnini
entities.what: Panel-bender maker; PT ATMI Solo lists a Salvagnini inline panel bender as a capacity.

entities.name: PKLNS
entities.what: South Korean maker of LED interactive boards, digital podiums and wall displays; Almik is its sole distributor (since 2017).

entities.name: SMKs and polytechnics (unnamed EDU CNC and Leanturn buyers)
entities.what: At least 45 EDULATHE/EDUMILL machines since 2009, mostly to SMKs and polytechnics, plus the first 10 Leanturns (Dec 2021). Buyers not named.

entities.name: KAP Ganung AB
entities.what: Surakarta public accounting firm; audited Yayasan Karya Bakti Surakarta's 2024 accounts (report dated 26 Sep 2025).

links.detail: ATMI's site: ATMI is 'part of the Mikael College and managed by the Indonesian Province Jesus Society', which it calls 'the owner' (undated page, pre-2021 director).
Wikipedia, citing a 2016 Springer book, calls it the 'Karya Bakti Foundation of the Indonesian Jesuits'; the foundation's officers are not published.
Jesuit province agenda lists 'Rapat Yayasan Karya ATMI' (28-29 Jun 2024) and the chair is a Jesuit; control is inferred.
ATMI lists STM (now SMK) Mikael Surakarta among works where Jesuits are 'pendiri, inspirator sekaligus pengelola' (founder, inspirer and manager).
ATMI has stood since 1968 'di bawah naungan Yayasan Karya Bakti Surakarta'; the foundation's audited 2024 accounts are published on ATMI's site.
Audited the foundation's 2024 accounts (SAK ETAP / ISAK 35) and gave an unqualified opinion; report dated 26 Sep 2025.
ATMI's history: founded in 1968 by Swiss Jesuit priests, 'Rm Chetelat, SJ'.
Took over ATMI's leadership three years after its founding (ATMI); the Jacobs Foundation credits him with leading the polytechnic and building 'a system financed largely by industry orders'.
Prize, not funding of ATMI: 2009 Best Practice Prize (Klaus J. Jacobs Awards) for his ATMI work; amount not stated.
'Didirikan oleh J.B. Casutt SJ'; first D3 intake of 36 students on 1 Sep 2003, prompted by ATMI Surakarta alumni and industry.
Early 2012 the polytechnic's production workshop became the limited company PT ATMI SOLO (EMIS: incorporated 23 Nov 2011); it trains ATMI and SMK Mikael students. Shareholders not published.
ARBURG calls ATMI IGI Center 'ATMI Polytechnic's teaching industry in mold making and plastic injection'; shareholders not published.
A 2016 UGM thesis lists PT ATMI Duta Engineering among ATMI Group's nine business units (first priority for investment); ADE says it serves ATMI's production-based education.
The 2016 UGM thesis names PT ATMI BizDEC as an ATMI Group business unit (first priority for investment); ATMI calls BizDEC its consultancy.
The 2016 UGM thesis names PT ATMI Kreasi Energi as an ATMI Group business unit (first priority for investment); listed under 'Industry' on ATMI's site.
Founded 28 Dec 2003 in Surakarta by 'Politeknik ATMI St. Mikael Surakarta' with its alumni, to distribute ATMI products and supply ATMI's needs.
Named by Almik as a shareholder ('Yayasan Karya Bhakti Surakarta'); stake not given.
Named by Almik as a shareholder; stake not given.
Alumni cooperative named by Almik as a shareholder; stake not given.
ATMI employees' cooperative named by Almik as a shareholder; stake not given.
Almik's profile: Yayasan Karya ATMI 'oversees Politeknik Industri ATMI Cikarang'; the polytechnic shows the foundation's chair first on its board page.
PT ATMI Cikarang began operating on 1 May 2014 'under the patronage of KARYA ATMI CIKARANG FOUNDATION' (read as Yayasan Karya ATMI); shareholding not published.
Sister polytechnic listed under 'Academic' on ATMI's site; founded by ATMI's former head Casutt and ATMI alumni; alumni share IKAMI.
Listed under 'Industry' on Politeknik ATMI Surakarta's site, although it sits under the Cikarang foundation.
Sister school on the Jl. Mojo 1 campus ('Kolese Mikael'); co-developed the EDU CNC machines with ATMI and PT ATMI Solo since 2009.
Only the name links it (ATMI + Mikael, same KBLI as ATMI-IGI); no source says who owns it.
Listed as an 'Academic' affiliate on ATMI's site; the nature of the tie is not stated, and Triputra's pages do not mention ATMI.
Director of Politeknik ATMI Surakarta since 2021; earlier director of the academy (2009-2012) and ATMI business and finance manager (2005-2007).
Vice Director IV for cooperation and career centre (Wadir 4, Bid. Kerjasama); presented ATMI's industry partnerships to LLDIKTI VI.
Signed ATMI Surakarta's website greeting as Director before Andreas Sugijopranoto took over in 2021.
Director of Politeknik Industri ATMI per its board page; moved there from teaching at ATMI Surakarta in Mar 2022.
Chair (Ketua) of Yayasan Karya ATMI per Polin ATMI's 'Yayasan & Direksi' page.
Director of PT ATMI-IGI Center (styled operations director in 2023-24 posts); signed as 'Director of ATMI Group' for the Apr 2026 LK MOU.
Chair (Ketua) of IKAMI, 2023-2026.
Alumni association of SMK Mikael, ATMI Surakarta and ATMI Cikarang; ATMI calls it 'pintu masuk ke industri' (alumni teach, host interns).
Director General of Vocational Education; attended the first Leanturn shipment at ATMI on 17 Dec 2021.
TKDN register lists 'ATMIPRO' as the brand of PT ATMI SOLO's Leanturn LT 300-100 CNC lathe (45.66%).
TKDN lists PT ATMI SOLO as certified producer of about 20 KIRANA DENTECH/GTECH/ORTECH/LABTECH devices (30.3-45.4%); who owns the marks is not shown.
Handles 'marketing dan penjualan' (marketing and sales) of the Leanturn lathe.
INAPROC e-catalogue listing 'ATMIPRO CNC Lathe Leanturn LT 300-100' (page 403; summary said 'TKDN: 0%', which conflicts with 45.66%).
Distributes ATMI workshop, office, hospital and school equipment as 'ATMI main business partner' (it predates the PT, set up for 'ATMI Surakarta products').
Sole distributor of South Korean PKLNS smart boards, digital podiums and displays since 1 Jan 2017.
Service, not parts: calculated the Leanturn's TKDN value (register now shows 45.66%).
